consensus_provenance_reaffirmation.correction_scope: The corrected consensus only relabels invalid historical provider output as non-creditable diagnostic material.

slc12a3_preservation.reason: SLC12A3 is an independently referential lexicalized biomedical identifier, so removing the adjacent generic type noun does not remove its denotation or restrictive identity. The V14 rule contains no case-specific SLC12A3 example.

case_assessments.participant_boundary_effect: Population heads and the with-RA and without-RA restrictions remain necessary to denote the compared cohorts; the rule does not alter comparison direction, roles, or outcome.

The independently referential carcinoma and 5-FU occurrences remain available without converting the patient noun into a new population participant; event focus, roles, and projection policy are unchanged.

The variants noun head and scientifically relevant detected-set scope remain preservable, while SLC12A3 remains independently denoting without the adjacent generic noun gene; uncertainty and classification rules are untouched.

The complete HCMV immediate-early proteins occurrence retains both the proteins noun head and the HCMV restriction. HCMV immediate-early is rejected as headless, and the HCMV restriction cannot be dropped in the current flat representation because the rule cannot create a compensating participant or link.
The before-ICI-initiation exposure restriction and the worse-OS outcome scope remain protected; the rule does not alter association polarity, direction, statistics, or event roles.
The lexicalized RA label and the non-RA NSCLC restriction remain source-grounded participant text; null-result polarity, comparison, P-value handling, and author interpretation are unchanged.

verdict_meaning: The exact V14 rule is source-general, case-leakage-free, and bounded to complete participant denotation. It preserves the noun head and restrictive identity required by the four-review consensus while leaving all event, role, link, root, semantic, evidence, completeness, grader, and BioNLP-CG policies unchanged. This review does not authorize provider execution or claim exposed-panel qualification.
